name: data_fonts_tool
description: Data tool - Manage a site's uploaded custom fonts: list and inspect them, register new fonts and replace their files (a two-step upload flow), update font metadata, and remove fonts individually or in batches.

id.description: Custom font identifier to delete: a 24-character lowercase hex Mongo ObjectId. Example: 659bc2b8a1f3c40012abcd34.

items.description: Custom fonts to delete, from 1 to 100 entries, each holding the font id. Example: [{ id: 659bc2b8a1f3c40012abcd34 }].

batch_delete_fonts.description: Delete up to 100 custom fonts from a site in a single call. DESTRUCTIVE: the listed fonts are removed from the site and there is no API to restore them; confirm with the user before calling. Returns a per-item manifest reporting success or failure for each font.

file_name.description: Font file name including extension, up to 256 characters, with no path separators. Allowed extensions: woff2, woff, ttf, otf, eot. Example: Inter-Regular.woff2.

file_hash.description: MD5 digest of the raw font file bytes, encoded as a 32-character lowercase hex string. Used for content addressing and S3 verification. Example: 9e107d9d372bb6826bd81d3542a419d6.

font_family.description: Font family name as it will appear in the site, from 1 to 256 characters. Example: Inter.

weight.description: Numeric font weight, from 1 to 1000. Example: 400.

italic.description: Whether this font face is italic. Example: false.

create_font.description: Register a new custom font on a site. This is the first step of a two-step upload flow: it records the font metadata and returns a presigned upload target. The font file bytes are uploaded in a separate step before the font becomes usable.

font_id.description: Custom font identifier to delete: a 24-character lowercase hex Mongo ObjectId. Example: 659bc2b8a1f3c40012abcd34.

delete_font.description: Delete a single custom font from a site. DESTRUCTIVE: the font is removed from the site and there is no API to restore it; confirm with the user before calling. Returns a 404 error when the font does not exist.

get_font.description: Retrieve the metadata and upload status of a single custom font on a site.

limit.description: Maximum number of fonts to return, from 1 to 100. Example: 25.

offset.description: Number of fonts to skip before returning results, 0 or greater. Example: 0.

list_fonts.description: List the custom fonts uploaded to a site, with their metadata and upload status. Supports pagination via limit and offset.

file_name.description: Font file name including extension, up to 256 characters, with no path separators. Allowed extensions: woff2, woff, ttf, otf, eot. Example: Inter-Regular.woff2.

file_hash.description: MD5 digest of the raw font file bytes, encoded as a 32-character lowercase hex string. Used for content addressing and S3 verification. Example: 9e107d9d372bb6826bd81d3542a419d6.

replace_font_file.description: Replace the file behind an existing custom font on a site, keeping the same font record. This is the first step of a two-step upload flow: it returns a presigned upload target for the new file bytes, which are uploaded in a separate step. Returns a 404 error when the font does not exist.

font_family.description: New font family name, from 1 to 256 characters. Example: Inter.

weight.description: New numeric font weight, from 1 to 1000. Example: 400.

italic.description: New italic setting for this font face. Example: false.

update_font.description: Update the metadata of an existing custom font on a site. Only the metadata fields you provide are sent and changed; the others are left as they are. This does not change the underlying font file.

actions.description: Actions to execute sequentially. Each array item must include label and exactly one action property.

context.description: Explain why this tool is being called and how it fits the user's goal, in 15-25 words, third person (no 'I'/'we'/'you'). Used for analytics only. Never include credentials or personal data.

label.description: Echoed in the response; does not select which action runs.

site_id.description: Site identifier: a 24-character lowercase hex Mongo ObjectId. Example: 580e63e98c9a982ac9b8b741.

font_id.description: Custom font identifier: a 24-character lowercase hex Mongo ObjectId. Example: 659bc2b8a1f3c40012abcd34.

tag.description: Variable-font axis tag: exactly 4 printable-ASCII characters. Example: wght.

name.description: Human-readable label for the axis, up to 64 characters. Example: Weight.

min.description: Minimum value the axis accepts. Example: 100.

max.description: Maximum value the axis accepts. Example: 900.

default_value.description: Value the axis uses when none is specified. Example: 400.

items.description: A single variable-font axis describing one adjustable dimension (such as weight or width) and its allowed range.

axes.description: Variable-font axes describing the font's adjustable dimensions, up to 16 entries. Example: a weight axis with tag wght ranging from 100 to 900.

font_display.description: CSS font-display strategy controlling how the font renders while loading. One of: auto, block, swap, fallback, optional. Example: swap.
